notes: release:publish refuses to upload a zip ShipIt would reject. After electron-builder signs and notarizes, and before anything reaches the GitHub release, the script extracts the zip with ditto into a temp dir, mounts the dmg, compiles scripts/sqrlcheck.swift with swiftc and runs it on the extracted bundle against the dmg's app and, when present, /Applications/TempCode.app (read only): the same SecStaticCodeCheckValidityWithErrors call with kSecCSCheckAllArchitectures | kSecCSCheckNestedCode | kSecCSStrictValidate against the installed app's designated requirement that Squirrel's SQRLCodeSignature makes on ShipIt's copy of the update, which is where the 1.0.205 install died on 2026-10-10 ("Helpers/chrome_crashpad_handler … invalid signature"). Without a Swift toolchain it falls back to codesign --verify --deep --strict. On failure it prints why, unmounts, deletes the draft release electron-builder opened so a fixed build can run again, and exits 1. Dry run on the published 1.0.205 artifacts in dist/: the extracted zip passes against both the dmg's app and the installed 1.0.200 (identical requirement: identifier dev.landon.tempcode, Developer ID, team XMTX47WA89), so the artifact that was served validates today and the 02:17 failure was not a bad zip. electron-builder.yml keeps scripts/*.swift out of the bundle.
